notes: WordPress: per-day date archive https://island.lk/YYYY/MM/DD/ (paginated, ~20 posts/page) plus that day's RSS at .../feed/; third template is the last WP-core post chunk (/wp-sitemap.xml lists post chunks 1..42, chunk 42 spans 2026-09-10..2026-10-25 so it covers the window and freezes there), where the checker's lastmod==date filter gives 30/56/78 URLs for 09-30/10-10/10-20. URLs are dateless single-segment slugs, hence the 2+ hyphen requirement, which also drops nav noise like /archives/, /conatct-us/, /feed/. robots.txt allows *, only named AI training bots are blocked.
